children: Overview
Hong Kong battery trading and tech services firm's interim revenue rose 34% yr/yr after business shift
Net profit for the period reached RMB186 mln, reversing prior yr loss
Company completed exit from vehicle manufacturing, now operates asset-light battery trading and tech services
Outlook
Company plans to expand technical services business in Europe and seek new customers
Company expects battery trading business to ramp up and become an additional revenue driver
Company continues debt restructuring talks with creditors and aims to resume share trading
China Evergrande New Energy Vehicle targets approximately RMB60 mln in battery-trading sales in the first 12 months after launch
Result Drivers
BATTERY TRADING BUSINESS - First sales from battery trading generated all revenue for the period
COST CONTROL - Administrative expenses dropped 41% due to continued cost control measures
EXCHANGE GAINS - Net profit boosted by exchange gains on borrowings
